text: A module step drains only the workers whose Thread.start has returned (#405, #406). The observer registers a worker before starting it, so its checks recognize the new thread, but Thread.join refuses a thread that hasn't started. Under the plumbing sandbox's parallel load, a step's drain met a descendant its parent was still starting, and the run ended as if it had timed out. A worker finishes starting its own before it ends, so draining started workers still reaches every descendant, and a registered worker that never starts still fails the step.
